optional_exports: PDF rendered from the same bundle
ad_hoc_dashboard_policy: dashboard-index.json lists deterministic per-country dashboard slices scoped to the selected documents; these never replace Prime and need no separate model extraction
translation_policy: full aligned English artifacts are immutable and referenced by hash; do not duplicate all translation bytes in every bundle
reading_policy: opening or filtering a published bundle requires no LLM call
selection_policy: one selected Prime manifest per country; separate ad hoc manifests and history
